# Block `steps`

**Use:** A worked example or procedure with numbered steps, each with a short Markdown explanation.

**Avoid:** Steps without explanation — use the order-items widget to practise a sequence.

## Example

```json
{
  "kind": "steps",
  "title": "Solving 2x + 3 = 11",
  "intro": "Isolate x one operation at a time.",
  "steps": [
    {
      "title": "Subtract 3",
      "md": "2x = 8"
    },
    {
      "title": "Divide by 2",
      "md": "x = 4"
    }
  ],
  "source": [
    {
      "file": "slides.pdf",
      "page": 4
    }
  ]
}
```

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"steps"` | yes |
| `source` | array of object (1–5) | no |
| `source[].file` | string | yes |
| `source[].page` | integer (≤ 9007199254740991) | yes |
| `title` | string | yes |
| `intro` | string | no |
| `steps` | array of object | yes |
| `steps[].title` | string | yes |
| `steps[].md` | string | yes |

Every block may carry `source`: 1–5 `{ "file", "page" }` references to the material it came from.
